description: Read PUBLIC centralized-exchange market data from Binance, OKX or Bybit: spot/perp ticker, orderbook depth, perp funding rate, mark price, and open interest. Keyless public endpoints only — no account, no trading, never signs.

coin.description: Base asset, e.g. BTC. Full exchange symbols also accepted.

market.description: spot or perp (default: spot; funding/openInterest force perp)

op.description: ticker, orderbook, funding, markPrice, or openInterest (default: ticker)

venue.description: binance, okx, bybit, or all (default: all)

name: cex_market_data
